about: EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER until club staff confirm the real values (see CLAUDE.md). filedPerMemberPerDay: the most damage reports one member can file in 24 hours (staff are not limited; 0 means no limit). majorPriority and minorPriority: the priority a report starts with when its filer says it is major, and when not (1 is the most urgent, 4 the least; staff can change it afterwards, the way iCrew's 1 to 4 works). The rest are the longest text, in characters, each box takes: descriptionMax (what is wrong) and locationMax (where on the boat) are shown to every member who books the boat; howMax (how it happened) is for staff only.
